description: This file defines the MainContentViewSubscriber class, which subscribes to view events in Drupal to render main content arrays into responses, handling different wrapper formats and cacheability.

classes.name: MainContentViewSubscriber
classes.description: A Drupal event subscriber that renders main content arrays into responses, supporting different wrapper formats and cacheability.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class resolver, route match, and main content renderers.

methods.name: onViewRenderArray
methods.description: Handles the view event to render a main content array into a response, applying wrapper formats and cache dependencies.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the Kernel's VIEW event.
